interpretation: The stored numeric values compare equal (0.0 == -0.0), and all recorded after-state digests are reproduced by these sign-bit-only changes. Thus exact numerical equality holds for the reconstructed state, while byte/digest identity does not.
method: Pure-file parse of canonical-state.json; apply only the listed signed-zero changes in memory; recompute SHA-256 over sorted compact JSON using the builder digest format. No Blender process or source/model write was used.
